verdict.rationale: Probes found no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger file: every candidate path returned 404. Kit does expose machine-readable documentation in other forms: an llms.txt index, per-endpoint Markdown API reference pages, and a Developer Docs MCP that lets agents query the full API reference live. These are adjacent substitutes, not a structured, downloadable API spec. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger (or equivalent structured schema) file, documentation of where to download it, and independent corroboration of spec availability.
